nights.title: PRESIDENT - Blood of Your Empire: United Kingdom Campaign 2026
nights.name: President
nights.extract: President are an anonymous English band formed in 2025, who blend metalcore with electronica. The band had released no music and were unknown until they were announced to play at that year's Download Festival, sparking speculation about their identity. Their frontman, the eponymous President, is described by Revolver as "silver-haired, wearing an eerie, not-quite-lifelike mask etched with deep wrinkles and radiating wax-figure unease". They released their debut EP, King of Terrors, in 2025. Their debut studio album, Blood of Your Empire, was released on 4 September 2026.

en.who: President are an anonymous English band formed in 2025, who blend metalcore with electronica. The band had released no music and were unknown until they were announced to play at that year's Download Festival.
facts: Their debut studio album, Blood of Your Empire, was released on 4 September 2026.
They released their debut EP, King of Terrors, in 2025.

facts: Ihr Debütalbum Blood of Your Empire erschien am 4. September 2026.
Ihre Debüt-EP King of Terrors veröffentlichten sie 2025.

tr.who: President, 2025'te kurulmuş, kimliği belirsiz bir ingiliz grubu; metalcore'u elektronikle harmanlıyorlar. grup o yılın download festivali'nde çalacağı açıklanana kadar hiç müzik yayımlamamış ve bilinmiyordu.
facts: ilk stüdyo albümleri blood of your empire, 4 eylül 2026'da yayımlandı.
ilk ep'leri king of terrors'ı 2025'te yayımladılar.

nights.title: The Stylistics
nights.name: The Stylistics
nights.extract: The Stylistics are an American Philadelphia soul group that achieved their greatest chart success in the 1970s. They formed in 1968, with a lineup of singers Russell Thompkins Jr., Herb Murrell, Airrion Love, James Smith, and James Dunn. All of their U.S. hits were ballads characterized by the falsetto of Russell Thompkins Jr. and the production of Thom Bell. During the early 1970s, the group had twelve consecutive R&B top ten hits including "Stop, Look, Listen", "You Are Everything", "Betcha by Golly, Wow", "I'm Stone in Love with You", "Break Up to Make Up", "People Make the World Go Round" and "You Make Me Feel Brand New". They had five gold singles and three gold albums.

Sie erhielten fünf Gold-Singles und drei Gold-Alben.

nights.title: Del Amitri
nights.name: Del Amitri
nights.extract:
Del Amitri are a Scottish alternative rock band formed in Glasgow in 1980. 
They are best known for their 1990 single "Nothing Ever Happens", which reached No. 11 in the UK, and their 1995 hit "Roll to Me", which reached the top 10 in both Canada and the United States. They have released seven studio albums, five of which have reached the UK top 10. Del Amitri has sold over six million albums worldwide.

facts: They have released seven studio albums, five of which have reached the UK top 10.
Del Amitri has sold over six million albums worldwide.

de.who: Del Amitri sind eine schottische Alternative-Rock-Band, die 1980 in Glasgow gegründet wurde. Bekannt sind sie vor allem für ihre Single "Nothing Ever Happens" von 1990, die in Großbritannien Platz 11 erreichte.
facts: Sie haben sieben Studioalben veröffentlicht, fünf davon erreichten die britischen Top 10.
Del Amitri haben weltweit über sechs Millionen Alben verkauft.

nights.title: CATTY
nights.name: Catty
nights.extract: Catrin Hopkins, known professionally as CATTY, is a Welsh singer and songwriter. She began her music career in 2016 in the musical duo Dusky Grey, before becoming a solo artist and a songwriter. Since going solo, she has released the extended plays Healing Out of Spite and Bracing for Impact, as well as supporting various artists on tour, including Dylan and Stevie Nicks.

facts: Seit ihrer Solokarriere hat sie die EPs Healing Out of Spite und Bracing for Impact veröffentlicht.
Außerdem war sie auf Tour als Vorband verschiedener Künstler dabei, darunter Dylan und Stevie Nicks.
